description: Start a background job that applies one patch (status, set/adjust stock, set/adjust price) to every product matching the filter. Use it instead of bulk_update_products when more than 1000 products match. Stock is whole units; price is major units of the default currency, and prices in additional currencies are left as they are. Returns the job at once; it runs in batches, so follow its progress with get_product_bulk_job. A model runs one job at a time: if one is already queued or running the start is refused - read it with get_product_bulk_job by modelId.

filter.description: Products to update; omit to update every product of the model

priceMax.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

priceMin.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug (from list_models)

patch.description: Single patch applied to every selected record

adjustPrice.description: Delta to price (major units of the default currency, +/-)

setPrice.description: Set absolute price (major units of the default currency - the stored price field value, 49.99 = $49.99)

name: start_bulk_update_products
title: Start bulk update products
